# Documentation Artifacts

Technical documents generated by the `software-engineer` agent via the `/create-documentation` prompt.

## Expected Artifacts

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `adr/` | Architecture Decision Records |
| `adr/README.md` | ADR index |
| `adr/adr-NNN-slug.md` | Individual ADR |
| `api/` | API documentation |
| `api/openapi.yaml` | OpenAPI 3.0 specification |
| `architecture.md` | Architecture documentation (C4 Model) |
| `contributing-guide.md` | Contribution guide |
| `deploy-guide.md` | Deployment and operations guide |
